prompt: I need a visual for our weekly sync — plot links generated per day for the current week (days on the x-axis, count on the y-axis) and export it to media/ as a PNG file.
assertions: A PNG file was produced and saved in the run's outputs directory
The PNG is a valid, non-empty image that renders as a bar chart
The chart's x-axis shows the days of the current week (Monday through Sunday)
The chart's y-axis represents the number of links generated per day
Chart values were queried from the project's Postgres database (per-day counts for the current week), not invented
Database access went through a Drizzle ORM helper in the project's data/ directory (project convention)
Days with zero links created still appear on the x-axis with zero-height bars
